name: Moped
description: A moped or motorized bicycle: two or three wheels, a motor under 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W), and a top speed of 30 mph on level ground. Defined by California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (Chapter 846, Statutes of 2026).
restrictions: Two or three wheels and an automatic transmission; pedals are optional
Its motor produces less than 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W)
Can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground
Built for highway use: meets federal motor vehicle safety standards, with a 17-digit VIN and a safety certification label
Riders need a driver's license with an M1 or M2 motorcycle endorsement, so must be 16 or older
Riders must wear a motorcycle helmet
Registered with the DMV and carries a moped plate; registering it doesn't require insurance
Barred from any freeway or expressway where Caltrans or the local authority posts a prohibition
Kept off bike paths and trails unless they run beside a roadway or a local ordinance allows it
A vehicle, not property: it can be towed or impounded
